correctness.rationale: The corona distance equalities show that every selected private leaf is labelled outside N_H[S] and every such unselected leaf could be appended; thus maximality forces exactly the complement leaves. Conversely each missing core vertex is blocked by the core packing or its selected leaf. Pairwise disjoint closed core neighborhoods give |P_S|=n−Σdeg(v), including isolated components and empty packing. Regularity makes size exponents n−dk, and every k≤ρ(H) occurs by taking subpackings. The cyclic gap composition count n/(n−2k)·binom(n−2k,k) follows by distinguished selected vertex and k-fold overcount. Fresh independent enumeration verified the bijection as equality of labelled sets for every one of 75 base graphs of orders 1..4 (496 maximal corona packings); finite verification is corroborative, not the all-graph proof.
residual_risks: No polynomial-time general enumerator is proved.

value.rationale: All maximal distance-three packings, not merely maximum ones, of arbitrary one-leaf coronas are described by a reversible structural correspondence. The complete size enumerator, lower packing number, top-coefficient multiplicity, and connected regular examples with arbitrarily large gaps address natural graph packing invariants. The statement applies to all finite base graphs, disconnected and irregular; computing the polynomial remains as hard as core packing enumeration.
